product_one_liner.value: Nanonets provides AI agents that read, validate, route, and post information from documents to automate document-heavy business workflows for enterprise teams in areas such as accounts payable, order management, logistics, and healthcare revenue cycle.

pricing_page.notes: The public page lists pricing plans and per-run prices.

named_customers.notes: Both appear in Nanonets’ customer case-study index.

employee_band.notes: Current counts are about 325–327 (LinkedIn shows 327 employee profiles; Crustdata reports 325 as of September 2026), within 201–500. LinkedIn’s separate company-size label says 51–200, so the band is based on the explicit profile counts.

hq_location.notes: The company profile lists San Francisco, California, United States as headquarters.

founded_year.notes: Nanonets’ LinkedIn company profile lists its founding year as 2017.

eng_blog.notes: The research index lists multiple model-release and technical research posts. OCR-2 discusses model training and is by Souvik Mandal, identified as a deep-learning engineer; OCR-3 describes its MoE architecture and training.

public_docs.notes: The public documentation site contains an overview and multiple product, API, setup, and workflow articles.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The current Nanonets job board lists a Deep Learning Engineer role.

model_provider.value: Nanonets says OCR-3 is its proprietary model; it publicly identifies Qwen2.5-VL-3B as the base model for the OCR-2 VLM.
model_provider.notes: The Qwen disclosure is specific to OCR-2; the cited current homepage describes OCR-3 as proprietary.

compliance_certs.notes: The homepage says SOC 2 Type II certified, GDPR aligned, ISO 27001 compliant, and that a HIPAA BAA is available for enterprise plans; it does not name PCI DSS.

last_funding.notes: The latest listed round was announced March 12, 2024; reported as $29 million Series B.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest recorded round is the March 2024 Series B, earlier than the 18-month window beginning May 9, 2025.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The current careers board lists an Enterprise Account Executive opening, and its live posting is available.

launched_6mo.notes: Nanonets’ Atlas launch is dated June 26, 2026, within May 9–November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: LinkedIn shows Shubhra Mishra currently as Vice President, Strategic Initiatives at Nanonets, with a start date of March 2026, inside the year before November 9, 2026.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The integrations page names both in its CRM, ticketing, and collaboration integrations.
